name: Apify
description: Cloud platform for web scraping and browser automation that enables users to develop, run, and share serverless microapps (Actors).

evidence.claim: Apify provides programmatic access via a RESTful HTTP API version 2.
Official API tokens are used via Authorization header or token query parameter.
Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exists at mcp.apify.com for AI applications and agents.

notes: Apify provides a full REST API v2, official SDKs for Node.js and Python, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agent integration.
